title.narrative: TCO continued in 2025 to support displaced children and families along the Thai Myanmar border and in Migrant Learning Centres, providing life-saving support and working with partners to build long term resilience. Emergency relief was also provided to children affected by regional flooding, and those displaced by conflict along the Thai Cambodia border, ensuring a speedy return to normalcy. In addition, UNICEF promoted Thailand's climate resilience by integrating climate-smart education and youth participation into national policy, training educators and youth, and empowering young voices in climate decision-making.
